# nemau compute instance resize

Resize an instance.

All three values are required: the API does not accept a partial resize.
Bounds: 1-64 vCPUs, 1024-262144 MB, 10-5000 GB.

Raising only the disk is applied online and the instance keeps running. Changing
vCPUs or memory power-cycles it, because without hotplug the hypervisor would
otherwise leave the change pending until the next boot.

## Usage

```
nemau compute instance resize <id> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --disk int    disk in GB (required)
      --ram int     memory in MB (required)
      --vcpus int   number of vCPUs (required)
```

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
